summary:
NVIDIA 營收翻倍突破 962 億美元，EPS 超預期 6.16%，展現強勁的 AI 晶片需求與獲利能力。
• 季度營收達 962.2 億美元，年增率高達 105.85%，顯示 AI 基礎設施需求依然極為強勁。
• 稀釋後每股盈餘 (EPS) 為 2.22 美元，超越市場預期的 2.09 美元，獲利能力持續優化。
• 在強勁的獲利增長下，滾動本益比 (Trailing PE) 降至 27.73 倍，估值具備極高吸引力。
ai_view:
本季財報釋放強烈看漲訊號。營收翻倍且估值（PE 27.73倍）相較其高成長性顯得相當便宜，消除了市場對 AI 泡沫的疑慮。短期內將對股價形成強力支撐，中期有望引領科技股續創佳績。後續應密切追蹤下一代 Blackwell 晶片的量產進度、台積電先進封裝產能擴張，以及主要雲端服務商（CSP）的資本支出展望。

需留意：供應鏈產能瓶頸（如 CoWoS 封裝）可能限制未來幾季的晶片出貨上限。；地緣政治與出口管制政策變化，可能影響特定區域市場的營收動能。

summary_en:
NVIDIA delivers outstanding results with revenue doubling to $96.22B and EPS beating estimates by 6.16% on relentless AI demand.
• Quarterly revenue reached $96.22B, up 105.85% YoY, demonstrating relentless demand for AI infrastructure.
• Diluted EPS of $2.22 beat the consensus estimate of $2.09, reflecting strong operating leverage and profitability.
• Trailing PE compressed to 27.73x despite massive growth, indicating highly attractive valuation relative to earnings power.

ai_view_en:
This earnings report delivers a highly bullish signal. Doubling revenue with a compressed PE of 27.73x dispels AI bubble fears and highlights immense earnings power. This should provide strong short-term price support and drive mid-term tech sector leadership. Key metrics to track going forward include Blackwell architecture ramp-up progress, TSMC advanced packaging capacity expansion, and hyperscaler capex guidance.

Watch：Supply chain constraints, particularly in advanced packaging (CoWoS), may limit near-term shipment upside.; Geopolitical tensions and potential export control policy changes could impact revenue momentum in restricted regions.
beat_or_miss: 超預期：營收與 EPS 均超越市場共識，YoY 增長達 105.85%。
